title: Broadsheet exports (XLSX, CSV, PDF)
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.
build: src/lib/export/broadsheet-data.ts: for a year and course (or all) assemble one row per student carrying the team's scores: index_number, full_name, contact (from the roster), group_number, course_id, supervisor_score, panel_average_score, composite_final_score, is_locked. Sorted by course, group number, index number. Teams without scores are flagged incomplete.

src/lib/export/csv.ts: columns exactly index_number, full_name, contact, group_number, supervisor_score, panel_average_score, composite_final_score, is_locked; UTF-8 with BOM; prefix a single quote on cells starting with = + - or @.

src/lib/export/excel.ts (exceljs): one worksheet per programme, HTU-blue header, frozen header, weights in B1 and B2, composite as a live formula (ROUND(C*B1/100 + D*B2/100, 2)) with the cached result, landscape print setup. No contact column.

src/lib/export/pdf.tsx (@react-pdf/renderer): A4 landscape, repeating header, page numbers, a section per programme each ending with Head of Department and Dean signature lines; 'DRAFT - not published' banner when any team is unlocked. No contact column.
src/app/actions/generate-broadsheet.ts: coordinator or admin; input {academic_year_id, course_id | 'all', format}; runtime nodejs, maxDuration 60; returns {filename, mime, base64}.
/reports page: filters, preview table (first 50 rows with incomplete flags), three download buttons with loading states; client builds a Blob from base64.
Tests: CSV (header order, BOM, injection guard), XLSX read back with exceljs (sheet per programme, formula present), data assembly fixtures (no cross-programme rows), PDF buffer starts with %PDF.
rules: Grade classification column is not produced until thresholds are defined
acceptance: A programme's sheet contains only that programme's students
